title: Index selected SQLite JSON values
goal: Index scalar JSON paths and fixed collection positions in SQLite when lookups need a schema with explicit per-element sort order.

selectionNotes: Real Windows x64 SQLite migrations, physical schema and exact scalar/position query results. EF11 checks per-element metadata, null/empty/mixed sort lists, count mismatch and unsupported all-elements rejection. No query-plan, performance, SQL Server execution, other-platform or AOT claim.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: EF Core 11 requires .NET 11. No older-runtime EF11 route is offered.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Pinned SDK11.0.100 with EF11.0.0; independent SDK10.0.403/EF10.0.13 comparison.

language.name: C#

packageAssets: EF11/Relational/Sqlite lib/net11.0; older EF10 lib/net10.0. SQLitePCLRaw and native SQLite pinned in independent locks.
providers: Bundled SQLite on Windows x64; not SQL Server native JSON indexes.
platforms: Windows x64 executed; other native platforms not-tested.
constraints: Real Windows x64 SQLite migrations, physical schema and exact scalar/position query results. EF11 checks per-element metadata, null/empty/mixed sort lists, count mismatch and unsupported all-elements rejection. No query-plan, performance, SQL Server execution, other-platform or AOT claim.
prerequisites: Restore each standalone project with its declared SDK. Migrate a new in-memory SQLite database; no external service.
stabilityLimitations: Stable API; database engine and schema support remain provider-specific.

evidence.scope: Real SDK10.0.403/EF10.0.13 Windows x64 bundled SQLite: apply explicit expression-index migration, assert physical schema and exact scalar/fixed-position results. EF11-only metadata and rejection controls are in the separate current-consumer receipt. No performance, SQL Server, other-platform or AOT claim.
